name: Camarilla Pivot Reversal Scalp
entry_long: Each day, compute Camarilla levels from the previous day's high (H), low (L) and close (C): R3 = C + (H-L)*1.1/4, R4 = C + (H-L)*1.1/2, S3 = C - (H-L)*1.1/4, S4 = C - (H-L)*1.1/2. Go long when price falls to and reverses off S3 (candle closes back above S3 after touching/piercing it) for a mean-reversion scalp back toward the pivot/R1; alternatively treat a close beyond S4 as a breakdown-continuation long... (sources specify both reversal-at-S3 and breakout-at-S4 variants; this spec uses the S3 reversal variant since it is the most commonly cited scalping rule).
entry_short: Go short when price rises to and reverses off R3 (candle closes back below R3 after touching/piercing it), targeting a move back toward the pivot/R1.
stop: Stop just beyond S4 (for the S3-reversal long) or beyond R4 (for the R3-reversal short).
target: First target the next inner level (e.g. R1/S1 or the central pivot); fixed reward:risk ~1:1 to 2:1 commonly used.
filters: Best used on timeframes with less noise; 5-minute is noisier than 15m/30m so only take reversal signals with a clear rejection candle (long wick) at the level.
